text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why? I'm not holding myself back by
caring about
what other people think
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm running just for me, and... and it
blows!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm running just for me, and... and it
blows!
choice_data_list: Even so, you're still going to run, right?
Even so, you're still going to run, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Of course. I already made my decision.
choice_data_list: Even so, you're still going to run, right?
Even so, you're still going to run, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how many times I lose. No
matter how
lame I look, I'll keep at it
until I win!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: You're holding firmly onto that tenacity.
You're holding onto that tenacity properly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You know it. I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to keep running. That's
all there is
to it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No way! You already know that!
choice_data_list: Should we stop if you're not having fun?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Losing sucks. It's frustrating, but that's
how racing
works.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And I chose to race, so I'm not giving up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's have a review session. I
want to go
through every race I couldn't
win.
choice_data_list: Then there's only one thing left to do.
Then there's only one thing left to do, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's going to be so cringe watching
myself, but I
need to do more than just
run!
